title: INCIDENT — At approximately 8:45–9:00 p.m., Plaintiff purchased a Celsius drink at Sprouts (111 E. El Camino Real, Sunnyvale), entered the adjacent Ross Dress for Less (119 E. A nearby cashier remained silent. Detention ~three minutes; no receipt requested, no search, no police, no Ross merchandise recovered. Matter 35.
